Deleting the exact-tree cache and changing checkout contents rebuilds identical historical wire/packet. Lost history and explicitly injected cache-build failure preserve owner reason without inventing complete/empty data; independent code-side reading still works. prepare_evidence consumes real opened ReviewTrees measured states, not caller-invented complete flags. Prior maximum/two-size/restart/cancellation/race evidence remains credited; no early installed/UI requirement added.
